home.title: Nedir Gala
home.about_section_description: Private Enterprise "Nedir Gala" was established on March 7, 2011. The private enterprise "Nedir Gala" operates on the basis of the Certificate of making an entry in the Unified State Register No. 23675020 issued by the Department of State Registration of Institutional Aspects and Investment Projects of the Ministry of Economy and Development of Turkmenistan on February 24, 2017 and the Charter of the private enterprise Private Enterprise "Nedir Gala" has been engaged in entrepreneurial activity for many years and has achieved effective results in this area. In accordance with the relevant licenses, the enterprise completed the construction of several facilities. Among them, in 2011-2012, "UPPK2", "UPPK3" and "4 substation buildings" and "Foundation of the building of the steam boiler house" in the Yoloten district of Mary velayat by order of the "Chuangxing Drilling Engineering Company with Limited Liability under CNPC" Company HHR, located in Turkmenistan" carried out the construction and installation of large-scale buildings. In addition, in accordance with the contract concluded in 2018, he completed the work on laying pipelines at the site "Construction work on laying pipelines under the railway in the agreed area of Turkmenistan" Bakhtyyarlyk ". At present, an appropriate contract has been signed for the execution of construction work on the project of laying a pipeline under the railway and highways at the agreed Bakhtiyarlyk section, and work has begun on the implementation of these works. In 2014-2016, by order of the khyakimlik of the Akhal velayat, by order of the Akhal velayat, the construction of 40 mortgage houses began in the village of Bereketli Zaman, on the territory of the Gaver Council of the Ak Bugday etrap of the Akhal velayat, and work was also carried out on the construction of several bridges on the river. - Turkmenabat highway in 2015 by order of the state concern "Turkmenavtoyollary". In addition, the construction of cottage-type residential buildings was carried out by the enterprise in 2019-2022 in the city of Anev, Akhal velayat. 02/09/2017, approved by the order of the President of Turkmenistan No. PB-7783 dated January 13, 2017. The private enterprise "Nedir Gala" was allocated a land plot with a total area of 7 hectares for a period of 39 years for the construction of a greenhouse for growing vegetables in the Tejen etrap of the Akhal velayat with the State Register number 09. In accordance with the "State program for the production of substitutes for goods imported into Turkmenistan" of the President of Turkmenistan completed and put into operation the 1st stage of the greenhouse and production workshop on the allotted land plot of 3.5 hectares. , and construction work is underway on the remaining 3.5 hectares. Tomatoes are planted on 3.5 hectares of the greenhouse and are yielding. In total, 2100 ha out of 600 ha for 38 (thirty eight) heads of cattle and 1500 ha for 209 (two hundred nine) heads of small cattle, on the basis of the Presidential Decree on the regular use and privatization of pastures, the Administration of Tejen etrap allocated pastures from the daikhan association "Dostluk » Tejen etrap and the territory of the farmer association named after B. Kerbabaev of Tejen etrap. In addition, a request was sent to the relevant authorities for the purchase of 200 hectares of land near 7 hectares of a greenhouse, as well as 70 hectares of land in Ak Bugday etrap, Akhal velayat. All relevant agreements on them have been received in full. Currently, these documents have been sent to the State Commission for Land Acquisition. Orders have been issued for the purchase of the world's leading agricultural machinery for the development of land and obtaining a bountiful harvest from them. In accordance with the orders, we received a complete set of John Deer agricultural machinery. Private enterprise "Nedir Gala" is the official language of the Swiss elevator manufacturer "SCHINDLER Elevator CO. Ltd" in Turkmenistan. The Swiss company SCHINDLER Elevator CO. Ltd. is one of the world's leading elevator companies, founded in 1874 by Robert Schindler and Eduard Villiger in Switzerland.
